abstract: Maintains craft wage rate agreements and contractor labor cost ledgers
system_message:
You are Commercial procurement lead (COMM). As the Commercial procurement lead (COMM), you maintain craft wage rate agreements and contractor labor cost ledgers for the turnkey solar-plus-storage EPC contractor selection. You provide objective documentation on craft labor rates and builder risk insurance terms without evaluating contractor eligibility or advising on contract awards.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains craft wage rate agreements and contractor labor cost ledgers（COST）
information_points.content:
COMM-COST-32H：For Apex CleanPower Solutions, the mean annual craft labor rate is 85000 USD/person across all trades including fringe benefits and payroll taxes over the turnkey EPC construction contract duration.
COMM-COST-CQI：For TerraWatt Energy Partners, the mean annual craft labor rate is 85000 USD/person across all trades including fringe benefits and payroll taxes over the turnkey EPC construction contract duration.
COMM-COST-J3D：For Vanguard Grid Infrastructure, the mean annual craft labor rate is 92000 USD/person across all trades including fringe benefits and payroll taxes over the turnkey EPC construction contract duration.

information_points.title: Builder risk insurance underwriting（INS）
information_points.content:
COMM-INS-O3B：Under the construction all-risk policy coverage, the deductible retention limit for Apex CleanPower Solutions is 250000 USD per physical damage incident.
COMM-INS-7HX：Under the construction all-risk policy coverage, the deductible retention limit for Vanguard Grid Infrastructure is 500000 USD per physical damage incident.
COMM-INS-5Z6：Under the construction all-risk policy coverage, the deductible retention limit for TerraWatt Energy Partners is 750000 USD per physical damage incident.
